name: uk-self-employment-sa103
description: UK sole trader trading profits on the Self Assessment self-employment pages (SA103S short, SA103F full) for tax year 2026-27, with the 2025-26 figures for returns due by 31 January 2027. Covers who is taxed on trading profits, allowable expenses, the GBP 1,000 trading allowance, cash basis as the default from 2024-25, the tax year basis and the five-year spreading of transition profits, capital allowances (AIA GBP 1 million, 14% main pool from 6 April 2026, 40% first-year allowance), simplified expenses (55p a mile from 2026-27), trade losses and the sideways relief cap, Class 4 NIC, Making Tax Digital for Income Tax from 6 April 2026, filing deadlines, penalties and interest. Trigger: 'sole trader tax', 'SA103', 'allowable expenses', 'trading allowance', 'cash basis', 'basis period reform', 'transition profit', 'MTD for Income Tax'. Out of scope: partnerships (SA104), companies (uk-corporation-tax), NIC detail (uk-national-insurance), payments on account (uk-payments-on-account), Scot
